title: JetKVM Mini
summary: JetKVM Mini is a compact, affordable KVM-over-IP hardware device that enables remote keyboard, video, and mouse control of computers at the hardware level, representing a smaller and more accessible version of their existing remote KVM solution.
problem_solved: Enables IT administrators and home lab enthusiasts to remotely control computers and servers without physical proximity, useful for headless setups and remote troubleshooting.
why_valuable: Provides an affordable, plug-and-play hardware solution for remote KVM access, eliminating the need for physical presence when managing servers, workstations, or homelab equipment.
